sentences.en: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
sentences.zh: 如果我们那样对他太不好了，那将是不公平的。

sentences.en: I wanted this watch so badly I could taste it.
sentences.zh: 我想要这块手表都快尝到它的味道了。

sentences.en: When I was badly off, I fell back on him.
sentences.zh: 当我处境很糟糕的时候，我只能依靠他。

senses.zh: 坏, 差, 拙劣地非常, 在很大程度上不利地, 有害地
